title: Web Terminal Configuration
description: Configuration for the web-terminal extension. Streams a PTY to the browser over SSE and takes input via POST. A browser terminal is remote code execution by design: configure basic_auth or protect the listener otherwise before exposing it.

command.description: Executable to run inside the PTY (e.g. "/bin/bash").

writable.description: Whether client keystrokes are written to the PTY. Set to false for a read-only terminal.

serve_frontend.description: Whether to serve the bundled xterm.js client at "/". Enabled by default; set to false if you bring your own client for the /stream, /input and /resize endpoints.

basic_auth.description: Optional HTTP Basic authentication. When set, every endpoint (including / and /stream) requires credentials from the htpasswd data and/or the users map, and browsers show their native login dialog. Absent = no authentication.

htpasswd.description: htpasswd entries, one 'user:hash' per line. Supported hashes: bcrypt ($2a$/$2b$/$2y$, e.g. from 'htpasswd -B') and PBKDF2-SHA256 in passlib format ($pbkdf2-sha256$...). Blank lines and '#' comments are ignored.

users.description: Users as a name-to-plaintext-password map, for quick setups where hashing is not worth the ceremony. Merged with the htpasswd entries; a user may only be defined in one of the two. Prefer 'htpasswd' when the config may be seen by others.

realm.description: Realm shown in the browser's login prompt.

DataSource.description: A data source provided either inline or as a file path. Exactly one must be set.

inline.description: Data provided directly as a string.

file.description: Path to a file containing the data.
